pages.title: A sunny lobby · 1/3
paragraphs: It is ten forty on a sunny morning in a hotel lobby in Miami. Bruno walks to the front desk with two bags. He arrived three days ago from Brazil. His flight leaves at six tonight. A receptionist named Lia waits behind the desk. She smiles and greets him.
“Good morning. I’d like to check out of room four ten.” says Bruno. “Good morning, Mr. Costa. Did you enjoy your stay?” says Lia. “Yes, it was great. I arrived three days ago.” says Bruno.
